name: DescribeAlarms

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the event-triggered task resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group associated with the event-triggered task
parameters.help_zh: 报警任务关联的伸缩组的ID
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the event-triggered task
parameters.name: alarm_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The state of the event-triggered task. Valid values:

- ALARM: The alert condition is met.
- OK: The alert condition is not met.
- INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Insufficient data to determine whether the alert condition is met
parameters.help_zh:
报警任务的状态。取值范围：

- ALARM：报警，已满足报警条件。
- OK：正常，尚未满足报警条件。
- INSUFFICIENT_DATA：数据不足，不足以判断是否满足了报警条件
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the event-triggered task is enabled. Valid values:

- true: enabled.
- false: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
报警任务是否启用。取值范围：

- true：已启用。
- false：已停用
parameters.name: is_enable

parameters.help_en:
The type of the monitoring metric. Valid values:

- system: uses CloudMonitor system metrics.
- custom: uses custom metrics reported to CloudMonitor
parameters.help_zh:
监控项类型。取值范围：

- system：使用云监控系统指标。
- custom：使用上报到云监控的自定义指标
parameters.name: metric_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the monitoring metric
parameters.name: metric_name

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for paging queries. Settings the number of rows per page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the event-triggered task list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
报警任务列表的页码。起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number
